title: A minor barre version
summary: Lower one sound while keeping the root.

steps.title: A minor barre version
steps.body:
Fm means F minor: F, Ab and C. Keep the fret-1 barre and fret 3 on strings 5 and 4. Remove the extra pressed position on string 3 so the barre supplies fret 1 there too. A becomes Ab, one half step lower. Ab is the same sound as G#.

**Why it matters:** The same major-to-minor change you heard in open shapes works with a barre too.

steps.title: Read the positions
steps.body: Read frets 1, 3, 3, 1, 1, 1 from thick to thin. One finger spans fret 1. The changed sound is on string 3; the root remains F.

items.prompt: Play F, Ab and C together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Make it comfortable
steps.body: Clear the selection between F and Fm. Change only string 3 from fret 2 to fret 1 and listen to A becoming Ab. Practise just those two sounds first if the complete shape feels difficult.
